notes.title: Update 1.2.3 is Available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this small update, we continue to expand linguistic horizons, fix bugs, and improve Deathless. You can read the full list of changes below.

New
The game is available in Japanese.

In Settings, you can disable the introduction video when launching the game.
 Fixed
Bottomless Pot Relic. Fixed a bug which allowed adding the same card to the deck several times. Fixed a pop-up hint text which appeared when hovering over a locked favor in Feats of Glory.

Fixed an issue that caused text to overlap UI in the main menu.

Fixed the display of quotes in the Russian localization.

In Bestiary, character’s name is now centered correctly.

In Settings, hints for options no longer disappear when opening a dropdown list.

Difficulty is now displaying correctly in the lower right corner when changing localization during the journey.

When a player decides to forfeit, Health and Gold are now correctly placed and displaying correct data on the journey log screen.

Fixed a bug which caused the game to freeze during the Herbalist event if the player had 6 consumables.

Hero’s Path. Added an option to scroll long texts.

notes.title: Update 1.2.2: Difficulty, Balance, and Other Things
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!



In this update, we've paid special attention to the game’s difficulty and balance as well as a number of other things that you—our dear players— told us about in your feedback. Please continue to share your thoughts with us: it helps us make the game better!

We have made Cakewalk and Hike modes easier. Both new players and those who appreciate more relaxed gameplay will find these modes more comfortable.

At the same time, we haven’t forgotten about those who like a good challenge. Hard difficulty modes have become smoother while keeping their toughness intact.

Please give this update a try and share your impressions with us. Also, be sure to enable the "Send data to the developers" option in the settings: it will help us make the game even better.



Below, there is a full list of changes:

 
Cakewalk and Hike difficulty changes:
Random events where you can get Curses are no longer available.
 
Some relics and consumables are now available only on Feat of Glory difficulties:Relics

Battle Modifiers

Tough Enemy I, II, and III

Fury II and III

Shining Armor I, II, and III

Will to Live I, II, and III

Cursed Location

 
Boss balance changes:
Leshy. Oak Bark effect: value no longer increases when triggered.

Vodyanoy. Overseer effect: now grants Strength when an ally enters the Dying state.

Yaron. Added the Dark Sorcery intention.

Yaron. Burden effect: now removes 1 stack when triggered, not at the end of the turn.

 
Relic balance changes:
Silver Plate. It is now Uncommon instead of Rare.

Nettle Shirt. It is now Uncommon instead of Rare.

 
Feat of Glory difficulty changes:
Feat of Glory 1: battles became more difficult while rewards became more valuable. Favors: 1/2

Feat of Glory 2: the positions of foes are shuffled at the start of the battle.

Feat of Glory 3: foes cannot gain Defenseless.

Feat of Glory 4: all foes gain Vigor x1 when one of them dies. Favors: 1/3

Feat of Glory 5: in battles for relics and boss battles, foes gain Strength x1 at the start of the battle.

 
Other changes
Now, when choosing a Path, you can encounter more than one positive modifier that provides an additional reward for winning that battle.

Rewards and battle modifiers are now distributed more equally.

Added a button to the main menu that leads to the game's store page.

 
Fixes
When using the Catswort consumable, the effect is applied to the nearest living foe.

Bebok. The Armor effect no longer triggers if there are no living allies nearby.

Fixed a bug that blocked starting of a new journey after reopening the statistics screen of the completed run.

notes.title: Dark fantasy deckbuilder Deathless gets a new name as its final update lands
notes.notes:
Transpose the deckbuilding core of games like Slay the Spire into a dark fantasy setting, with art and creature designs inspired by classic RPGs and DnD, and inject a little of the positional combat trickery of Darkest Dungeon, and you have Deathless: The Hero Quest. Formerly known by a different subtitle, Tales of Old Rus, the roguelike now has a new name as developer 1C Game Studios delivers its conclusive, final update, including visual upgrades, a fresh opening cinematic, and a dangerous new opponent.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1: Rebalancing, Camera Settings, and Other Changes
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.1 is now live! The main changes include new combat camera settings, a new card layout, and hero, foe, and relic rebalancing.

1.0.1 Patch Notes

Font size increased on Steam Deck

Combat camera settings 
Dynamic: zoomed in, depth-of-field effect
Balanced: not zoomed in, depth-of-field effect
Static: not zoomed in, no depth-of-field effect

In combat, cards can either be dealt in a straight line or fanned out

The number of Prestige points earned at the end of a journey has been changed
- Winning an ordinary battle now earns you 10 Prestige rather than 5
- Defeating an ordinary boss now earns you 40, 80, or 120 Prestige for level 1, 2, and 3 respectively rather than 50 for all levels

Rebalanced foes
Koschey the Deathless:
- The Summon the Gloom intention no longer makes Koschey invulnerable to debuffs, but it can be used multiple times per battle
- Koschey regains 2/3 of his health when the battle moves to phase 2 and 1/3 when it moves to phase 3
- Every time the battle moves to a new phase, Koschey loses all debuffs, moves to the back position, and becomes invulnerable to buffs until the next round
- The Koschey’s Curse effect now stacks when the deck is reshuffled and does not decrease

Chudo Yudo now deals 4 damage instead of 5
Barker no longer uses the Dreadful Howl intention when left alone on the battlefield
Heretnik battle (step 14): one Striga has been replaced by a Slave Ghoul
For some battles, the range of steps at which they can be encountered has been changed

Rebalanced relics
- The Wooden Stake now grants Vigor x3 instead of 2
- The Birchbark Shoes are now Uncommon instead of Rare
- The Broken Mirror now applies Dizzy x2 instead of 1
- The Silver Dagger now activates at 12 cards instead of 10
The Clapper’s effect boost has been reduced from 2 to 1
- The Bell is now Rare instead of Uncommon and grants 2 AP instead of 1
- The Amber Charm now grants +25% Health instead of +20%
- The Golden Rose now grants 30 Gold instead of 25
- The Juicy Apple now grants Vigor x3 instead of 2

Rebalanced consumables
- Oak Moss now grants Resilience x4 instead of 3
- Goldroot now grants x5 Crimson Gold instead of 2
- Hopping Herb is now Rare instead of Epic
- Parsley is now Epic instead of Rare

Rebalanced Varvara’s cards
Note: the numbers in round brackets stand for the upgraded version of the card.

- Agility now costs 1(0) AP instead of 1(1) and grants Agility x2(2) instead of 2(3)
- Cleave now deals 7(9) damage instead of 5(7)
- Tactical Arrangement now costs 2(1) AP instead of 1(0) and applies Perplexed to all foes
- Fighting Back now deals 3(5) damage instead of 2(4)
- Fury now grants Vigor x2(3) instead of 2(2)
- Fair Share now steals 3(5) Armor instead of 2(3)
- Opportunism now grants an additional 1(2) Armor
- Vulnerable now costs 1(0) AP instead of 1(1) and applies Vulnerable x2(2) instead of 2(3)
- Piercing Strike now deals 6(6) damage instead of 5(5)
- Hiding now costs 2(2) AP instead of 2(1) and inflicts Dizzy x1(2) instead of 1(1)
Double Down! now costs 2(1) AP instead of 2(2)
- Dizziness now costs 1(0) AP instead of 1(1) and inflicts Dizzy x2(2) instead of 2(3)
- Scramble now applies Dizzy x2(3) instead of 1(2)
- Bestowal now costs 3(3) AP instead of 4(4)

Rebalanced Vasilisa’s cards
- Grand Entrance now costs 3(2) AP instead of 2(2) and deals 3(3) damage instead of 2(3)
- Absolution now deals 4(6) damage instead of 5(7)
- Cataclysm now costs 2(2) AP instead of 4(4), deals 2(3) damage instead of 4(6), and resets the Nursemaid’s charges when used
- Eagerness now grants 2(2) extra charges instead of 1(1)
- I’ve Got This! — updated description: draw 1(2) card(s) and gain 2 AP for every charged Nursemaid on the battlefield. Reset their charges. Forget this card
- Bare Essentials now grants 1(2) card(s) from the Draw Deck (you could choose fewer cards before)

[previewyoutube=eZuMIamSZyE;full][/previewyoutube]

Patchnotes 1.0
You can now battle Koschey.
The battle is available at the end of the journey. It is unlocked by completing each Hero’s Path.
All legendary bosses now drop relics that should aid you in the battle against Koschey.
Added five new random events.

New consumables

 6 Common consumables
 4 consumables exclusive to Dobrynya
 4 consumables exclusive to Alyosha

New relics

 1 relic dropped by regular bosses
 4 relics exclusive to Dobrynya
 4 relics exclusive to Alyosha
 4 relics dropped by legendary bosses

Rebalanced relics

 Amber Charm: additional healing increased from 10% to 20%.
 Silver Dagger: the number of cards in the deck is now counted starting from the 7th card instead of the 5th one.
 The Swamper Toxin now inflicts Fatigue x2 instead of 1.
 The Cursed Lash is now Epic instead of Rare.
 The Karkolist Oak Leaf now grants foes Regen x2 instead of 3.
 The Tattered Pouch now grants 250 Gold instead of 200.
 The Cursed Charm is now Uncommon instead of Rare.
 The Wishing Doll is now Rare instead of Epic.
 Eight relics have been completely revamped.
 The Ring of Oblivion has been replaced by the Silver Ring. Updated description: draw 2 cards if you drew fewer than 2 Attacks at the start of the turn.
 Silver Spoon — updated description: draw 2 cards if you drew fewer than 2 Skills at the start of the turn.
 Ornate Sash — updated description: gain 1 base Armor after taking 6+ damage during a single turn.
 The Bogatyr’s Shirt is now Rare instead of Uncommon. Updated description: when taking health damage, inflict a random debuff on the attacker.

 Moonstone Charm — updated description: inflict Bleeding x2 on all foes at the start of the battle. When taking health damage, inflict Bleeding x1 on the attacker.

Rebalanced Vasilisa

 Base health reduced from 50 to 40.
 Revamped the way Nursemaids gain and spend charges.
 Updated the Nursemaids’ abilities.
 Updated all cards involving Nursemaids, gaining energy, and drawing cards.

Rebalanced Dobrynya

 Base health reduced from 55 to 50.
 Dobrynya’s Cards
 Heavy Shield: cost of the upgraded version decreased from 2 to 1 AP; the regular version now grants 7 Armor instead of 5.
 The Fire-Breathing Shield now damages all living foes.
 Sick and Tired+ now costs 2 AP instead of 1 and inflicts Fatigue x3 instead of 2.
 Death’s Call+ now costs 2 AP instead of 1 and inflicts Decay x2 instead of 1.
 Wrath is now Epic instead of Rare.
 Bogatyr’s Shield now grants 2 Armor instead of 3 (3 instead of 5 when upgraded); the hero gains Armor in both the current round and the next one.

  Yaron Likhorad can now perform an attack that does not inflict Burden.

Rebalanced regular foes

 Stolen cards are now listed in the description of the Stolen Cards effect.
 Added new achievements.
 The game is now available in Chinese.
 Added VFX when taking damage from various buffs, debuffs, and relics.
 The background edges are now darkened for users of widescreen monitors.
 Updated the images on Varvara’s cards.
 Added four new random events.
 Icons are now displayed alongside tooltip names.

Bug fixes

 Fixed an issue that occurred when attempting to transform a Grace card.
 Adjusted the description of the Blinded effect.
 Fixed an error in the Corrupted Sorcerer’s Adept of the Gloom effect.
 Fixed a page description that remained unchanged regardless of the hero’s gender in the Russian version.

 Bandit, Bandit Leader: the fleeing animation is no longer disrupted if the foe takes damage at the start of the turn.

 Feat of Glory 8 now decreases max. health properly if the hero ends a battle at 1 Health.
 In the random event featuring a witch, failing the challenge now gives you the correct Curse.
 When opening a dropdown menu using a controller, the topmost element is displayed immediately.
 Adjusted the icon of the Heretnik’s blocked Charge Attack intention.
 Changed the color of highlighted terms on the selection screen in random events where you select a consumable to give away.
 Ramming Shield (Dobrynya): fixed an issue that caused the targets to move when there were multiple Dying foes on the battlefield.
 Bestiary: the buttons of missing animations for all characters are now grayed out properly.
 The hero’s status bar can be viewed during the dialogue before the battle starts.
 The journey deck can now be properly filtered by card type.
 Alyosha’s Overheat is now calculated correctly when playing a Spellbane card with an AP cost of 2+.

notes.notes:
During the Early Access stage, the dev team was actively communicating with the community and collecting players’ reviews. Thanks to this feedback, the project received a number of improvements: Bestiary, reworked UI, gamepad support, Feats of Glory, and more.

“During Early Access, the game managed to accumulate an active player community which was especially impressed with the game’s gameplay and replay value, authentic characters and locations of Belosvet, and the signature soundtrack.
We are extremely grateful to our community for their support and feedback. Every comment, idea, and suggestion helped us create the game that inspires and excites”, said Denis Maltzev, the game’s producer.

In the final version of the game, players will be able to challenge Koschey the Deathless and learn how the story ends.

Thank you for the support during the EA!

 Added a new difficulty system: Feats of Glory.
 Feats of Glory provide effects that last until the end of the journey.

[previewyoutube=oY7-5VG7miM;full][/previewyoutube]

Added four difficulty modes.
Note that the difficulty you choose is active until the end of the run and cannot be changed during the playthrough.
 
Easy
Battles can be replayed. Your hand changes every time you replay a battle. Start your journey with the Honey Agate relic, which grants Strength x1 and Fortitude x1.
 
Normal
Battles can be replayed. Your hand does not change when you replay a battle.
 
Hard

 Make a backup of your saves. Here’s how:
 Press the Win + R keys, paste C:\Users\%Username%\AppData\LocalLow\1CGS\Deathless in the window that appears, and press Enter.
 Copy the contents of the folder to another location.
 When returning to the standard version of the game, replace the files with the saved ones.
 Please disable cloud saves for the game (Steam Cloud). This can be done in the game properties, under the "General" tab.

 Open Steam and right-click on "Deathless".
 Select "Properties..." and go to the "Betas" tab.
 Select the branch named public_beta from the dropdown menu.
